items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: One of them was called Cousin Sport and Cousin something, I don't know.

ctx.x: What do you think? Jimmy said he didn't know, but he said thought you would know.

Well, unlike Jimmy, I don't really know too much about that. I always saw them as adversaries, you know? My recollection of it is because it seems to me that Lester felt as though, and rightfully so, you know -- he proved that he was right -- that he was much better, and Cousin Sport or Cousin Boots, whichever one it was, they tried to hold him back, you know, he didn't feel as though ... but

that could be because of his zeal as a young person, you know, and so I don't know. Maybe they were helping him and in his young mind, he may have thought they were trying to hold him back, you know, as the saying goes --but I don't really think so. I think, if anything, I would probably lean towards what Jimmy was saying, but anyone who picked up a saxophone, you know ... Lester wanted some of it, as the saying goes -- you know, he really wanted to see who was the better man; it would be just like a prize…
